questions.prompt: USA scored 100 goals and France scored 64 goals. How many more goals did USA score than France?

questions.subject: math
questions.prompt: China scored 88 goals and Japan scored 58 goals. What is the average number of goals scored by these two teams?
questions.explanation: Add the goals together: 88 + 58 = 146. Then divide by 2: 146 ÷ 2 = 73.

questions.subject: math
questions.prompt: Japan played 58 matches at the Summer Olympics. They won 27 of those matches. What percentage of their matches did Japan win? Round to the nearest whole number.
questions.sourceFact: Japan wins: 27; Japan total results (wins + draws + losses): 58
questions.explanation: Divide wins by total matches: 27 ÷ 58 ≈ 0.466. Multiply by 100: 46.6%. Rounded to the nearest whole number: 47%.
